text: Select: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, pChEMBL value. Source: activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id, assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid, activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741214', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Sort: molecule ChEMBL ID ASC, assay ChEMBL ID ASC. Limit: 1000.
